patch_description: Replace the naive random point generation with a deterministic Heilbronn optimizer for 13 points: 3-fold symmetric ring+center initialization, annealed soft-min (LogSumExp) maximization via L-BFGS-B to get smooth gradients, projection into the unit square, then greedy coordinate-perturbation refinement on the exact minimum triangle area. Multi-start over 4 deterministic seeds keeps results reproducible.
